title: When harshness has become your default
issueStatement: Your speech lands harder than you mean, and inwardly the same sharpness keeps rehearsing itself long after the conversation ends.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not ask for gentleness as etiquette. It asks for a heart softened by praise, humility, and regard for the one standing before you.
practicalReflection: Harshness often disguises itself as honesty or efficiency. Its deeper root is usually ego refusing to lower its temperature.
actionPrompt: Before the next hard sentence leaves your mouth, lower its heat without lowering its truth.
